in_marathi.name: Rajaram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rajaram signifies a person who is a ruler, a king, a monarch, or a chief. It also implies peace, calmness, and tranquility. The name is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Raj' and 'Aaram'. Raj means rule, royalty, and power, while Aaram means peace, calmness, and rest.
